## README.md
> **This dataset has moved.** It is now published, updated and extended as [Field blocks for Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_mv) in the [Harmonized Field Boundary Data](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data) catalog. # Field boundaries for Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania (MV), Germany

Provides ca. 70.000 official field boundaries from the federal state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania (MV) in Germany.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from a file that was provided by the state.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Ministerium für Landwirtschaft und Umwelt M-V](https://www.geodaten-mv.de/dienste/feldblock_atom?type=dataset&id=f18122c4-2585-4c22-9c48-9e960e8dhd34)
- **Converted by:** [Matthias Mohr](https://mohr.ws)
- **License:** No restrictions apply

- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.7.0.
